scenarios.condition: CLI argc != 3 or argv[1] != '--spec'
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Invalid command-line invocation. Usage: publish_operator_pair.py --spec <path_to_spec.json>')

scenarios.condition: Spec file path does not exist on disk
scenarios.behavior: Raises FileNotFoundError('Spec file not found')

scenarios.condition: Spec file ancestry contains symlink or reparse point
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Path component ... is a reparse point / symlink')

scenarios.condition: Spec JSON contains duplicate keys, BOM, or missing required keys
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Duplicate key ...' or 'Missing required spec key ...')

scenarios.condition: Output directory already exists prior to publication
scenarios.behavior: Raises FileExistsError('Preexisting output root prohibited')

scenarios.condition: Output directory is relative or contains path traversal ('..')
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Path must be a fully-qualified local DOS path')

scenarios.condition: Output directory parent is an unsafe reparse point / junction
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Path component ... is a reparse point / symlink')

scenarios.condition: bundle_filename is not 'operator_startup_pair.json' or contains slashes
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Only fixed basename operator_startup_pair.json is supported')

scenarios.condition: Supplied config path does not exist on disk
scenarios.behavior: Raises FileNotFoundError

scenarios.condition: Supplied config path ancestry contains unsafe reparse point / symlink
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Path component ... is a reparse point / symlink')

scenarios.condition: Supplied config path does not match descriptor expectedConfigPath under Windows path equality
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... config path does not match descriptor expectedConfigPath')

scenarios.condition: Actual raw config file SHA-256 differs from descriptor expectedConfigSha256
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('... config SHA mismatch: declared vs actual')

scenarios.condition: Descriptor expectedConfigSha256 is not strictly 64 ASCII hex characters (e.g. whitespace-padded)
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('expectedConfigSha256 must be strictly 64 ASCII hex characters without padding')

scenarios.condition: Config schemaVersion != 'WE-OPERATOR-BOOTSTRAP-V1'
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('schemaVersion must strictly equal WE-OPERATOR-BOOTSTRAP-V1')

scenarios.condition: Config role != 'SIMULATION' (parent) or != 'READ_ONLY' (child) under exact raw match
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Parent/Child role mismatch ...')

scenarios.condition: Config configId is blank or does not match descriptor expectedConfigId under ordinal comparison
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('configId must be non-blank ...' or 'configId ordinal mismatch')

scenarios.condition: validatorArguments is non-blank (contains arguments)
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('validatorArguments must be blank in paired operator startup mode')

scenarios.condition: workerUserDataDirectory and validatorUserDataDirectory normalize to identical directory
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('workerUserDataDirectory and validatorUserDataDirectory must be distinct directories')

scenarios.condition: expectedContentProfileFingerprint is blank or not a string
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('expectedContentProfileFingerprint must be a non-blank string')

scenarios.condition: policyRevision is a boolean value (e.g. true / false)
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('policyRevision must not be a boolean')

scenarios.condition: expectedPackagePolicyDeclaration missing required keys or schemaVersion/policyId/policyRevision blank
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('Missing required package policy keys ...' or '... must be non-blank')

scenarios.condition: issuedAtUtc is not valid Gregorian UTC ISO 8601 with 'Z' suffix or calendar/time invalid
scenarios.behavior: Raises ValueError('issuedAtUtc must be a valid Gregorian UTC ISO 8601 string ...')

scenarios.condition: Final bundle destination file already exists when os.link is called
scenarios.behavior: Raises FileExistsError (raised natively by os.link on NTFS)
